name: Rest Position (Child's Pose)

load.note: Any light setting works — stay on whatever is already on if it feels supportive.

summary: Kneel on the carriage with hands on the footbar, sit back towards the heels and let the carriage slide away to lengthen the back and shoulders.
steps: Kneel on the carriage facing the footbar, hands on the bar.
Sit the hips back towards the heels and let the arms lengthen as the carriage glides away.
Breathe into the back of the ribs.

layers.title: Side reach
layers.text: Walk both hands to one end of the bar.

cautions.note: Cushion behind the knees or stay higher.

cues:
Heavy hips, long arms.
Let the head hang between the arms.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Knees wide to make room for the belly or hips
Cushion between heels and hips for sore knees
